title: MSFS 2024: Falcon 50 receives experimental update
summary: Contrail has released another experimental update for its Falcon 50.
body:
Contrail has released another experimental update for its Falcon 50.

Version **1.0.5-rc2** introduces several improvements, particularly to the aircraft's autopilot and autothrottle.

Notable changes include smoother pitch-trim operation, improved autothrottle stability with hardware controllers, corrections to navigation behaviour and better frame-rate performance.

The passenger cabin also receives an improvement: entertainment screens can now alternate between flight statistics and a live route map.

The update remains on the **experimental channel** while further testing continues. It has not yet become the standard public release.
